Subject: Project Aurora POC results — short reference and 15-min sync?

Hi Alicia,

Huge thanks again for partnering with us on Project Aurora. The team has wrapped the POC analytics and wanted to share a concise recap and a small ask if you're open.

Quick highlights (pilot vs baseline):
- Inference cost per 1k tokens: down ~62% (projected annualized saving $320k).
- P99 tail latency: improved from ~910ms to ~210ms.
- Throughput (concurrent requests sustained): 3.2x increase with the same instance footprint.
- Error rate on live ops traces: dropped from 4.5% to 0.35%.

Those gains are what we benchmarked end-to-end (RLHF model variant + prefix caching + dynamic batching). I attached the one-pager metrics PDF and a short screen capture of the console graphs.

Two small asks (would mean a lot to our GTM team):
1) A one- to two-line quote we can use in a case snippet (example: “Redwood cut our API costs and smoothed latency spikes during Black Friday testing.” — totally flexible).
2) A 15-minute call (recorded) with you or someone from ops so we can capture a brief testimonial and confirm customer-facing numbers. Nothing heavy — just top-line context.

If you're open, here are times that work for us (PDT):
- Thu 6/18 10:00–10:15
- Thu 6/18 15:30–15:45
- Fri 6/19 09:00–09:15

If none of those fit, tell me a slot that does and we’ll adapt.

Thanks again, Alicia — thrilled with what your team achieved here.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

- inference-screens.mp4 (30s console capture)
